ayahs.1: Aye logo! Apne parwardigaar se daro, jis ne tumhe ek jaan se paida kiya aur usi se us ki biwi ko paida karke un dono se bahut se mard aur aurten phaila din, us Allah se daro jis ke naam par ek doosre se maangte ho aur rishte naate todne se bhi bacho, beshak Allah ta'ala tum par nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.2: Aur yateemon ko un ke maal de do aur paak aur halaal cheez ke badle napaak aur haraam cheez na lo, aur apne maalon ke saath un ke maal mila kar kha na jaao, beshak yeh bahut bada gunaah hai.
ayahs.3: Agar tumhe dar ho ke yateem ladkiyon se nikaah karke tum insaaf na rakh sako ge to aur aurton mein se jo bhi tumhe achhi lagen tum un se nikaah kar lo, do do, teen teen, chaar chaar se, lekin agar tumhe barabari na kar sakne ka khauf ho to ek hi kaafi hai ya tumhari milkiyat ki laundi, yeh ziyaada qareeb hai ke (aisa karne se na-insaafi aur) ek taraf jhuk padne se bach jaao.
ayahs.4: Aur aurton ko un ke mehr raazi khushi de do, haan agar woh khud apni khushi se kuch mehr chhod den to use shauq se khush ho kar kha lo.
ayahs.5: Be-aqal logon ko apna maal na de do jis maal ko Allah ta'ala ne tumhari guzraan ke qaaim rakhne ka zariya banaya hai, haan unhe us maal se khilaao pilaao, pehnaao, odhaao aur unhe maqooliyat se narm baat kaho.
ayahs.6: Aur yateemon ko un ke baaligh ho jaane tak sudhaarte aur aazmaate raho, phir agar un mein tum hoshiyaari aur husn-e-tadbeer paao to unhe un ke maal saunp do aur un ke bade ho jaane ke dar se un ke maalon ko jaldi jaldi fizool kharchiyon mein tabaah na kar do, maaldaaron ko chaahiye ke (un ke maal se) bachte rahen, haan miskeen mohtaaj ho to dastoor ke mutaabiq waajibi taur se kha le, phir jab unhe un ke maal saunpo to gawaah bana lo, dar-asal hisaab lene wala Allah ta'ala hi kaafi hai.
ayahs.7: Maa baap aur khwesh-o-aqarib ke tarke mein mardon ka hissa bhi hai aur aurton ka bhi. (Jo maal maa baap aur khwesh-o-aqarib chhod maren) khwaah woh maal kam ho ya ziyaada (us mein) hissa muqarrar kiya hua hai.
ayahs.8: Aur jab taqseem ke waqt qaraabat-daar aur yateem aur miskeen aa jaayen to tum us mein se thoda bahut unhe bhi de do aur un se narmi se bolo.
ayahs.9: Aur chaahiye ke woh is baat se daren ke agar woh khud apne peechhe (nanhe nanhe) naatawaan bachche chhod jaate jin ke zaaya ho jaane ka andesha rehta hai, (to un ki chaahat kya hoti) pas Allah ta'ala se dar kar jachi tuli baat kaha karen.
ayahs.10: Jo log na-haq zulm se yateemon ka maal kha jaate hain, woh apne pait mein aag hi bhar rahe hain aur anqareeb woh dozakh mein jaayenge.
ayahs.11: Allah ta'ala tumhe tumhari aulaad ke baare mein hukm karta hai ke ek ladke ka hissa do ladkiyon ke baraabar hai aur agar sirf ladkiyaan hi hon aur do se ziyaada hon to unhe maal-e-matrooka ka do tihaai milega. Aur agar ek hi ladki ho to us ke liye aadha hai aur mayyat ke maa baap mein se har ek ke liye us ke chhode hue maal ka chhata hissa hai, agar us (mayyat) ki aulaad ho, aur agar aulaad na ho aur maa baap waaris hote hon to us ki maa ke liye teesra hissa hai, haan agar mayyat ke kai bhaai hon to phir us ki maa ka chhata hissa hai. Yeh hisse us wasiyyat (ki takmeel) ke baad hain jo marne wala kar gaya ho ya ada-e-qarz ke baad, tumhare baap hon ya tumhare bete tumhe nahi maloom ke un mein se kaun tumhe nafa pahunchaane mein ziyaada qareeb hai, yeh hisse Allah ta'ala ki taraf se muqarrar karda hain, beshak Allah ta'ala poore ilm aur kaamil hikmaton wala hai.
ayahs.12: Tumhari biwiyaan jo kuch chhod maren aur un ki aulaad na ho to aadhon aadh tumhara hai aur agar un ki aulaad ho to un ke chhode hue maal mein se tumhare liye chauthaai hissa hai. Us wasiyyat ki adaayegi ke baad jo woh kar gayi hon ya qarz ke baad. Aur jo (tarka) tum chhod jaao us mein un ke liye chauthaai hai, agar tumhari aulaad na ho aur agar tumhari aulaad ho to phir unhe tumhare tarke ka aathwaan hissa milega, us wasiyyat ke baad jo tum kar gaye ho aur qarz ki adaayegi ke baad. Aur jin ki miraas li jaati hai woh mard ya aurat kalala ho yani us ka baap beta na ho. Aur us ka ek bhaai ya ek behen ho to un dono mein se har ek ka chhata hissa hai aur us se ziyaada hon to ek tihaai mein sab shareek hain, us wasiyyat ke baad jo ki jaaye aur qarz ke baad jabke auron ka nuqsaan na kiya gaya ho, yeh muqarrar kiya hua Allah ta'ala ki taraf se hai aur Allah ta'ala daana hai, burdbaar.
ayahs.13: Yeh haden Allah ta'ala ki muqarrar ki hui hain aur jo Allah ta'ala ki aur us ke Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki farmabardaari karega use Allah ta'ala jannaton mein le jaayega jin ke neeche nahren beh rahi hain, jin mein woh hamesha rahenge aur yeh bahut badi kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.14: Aur jo shakhs Allah ta'ala ki aur us ke Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki naafarmaani kare aur us ki muqarrar hadon se aage nikle use woh jahannam mein daal dega jis mein woh hamesha rahega, aison hi ke liye ruswa-kun azaab hai.
ayahs.15: Tumhari aurton mein se jo be-hayaai ka kaam karen un par apne mein se chaar gawaah talab karo, agar woh gawaahi den to un aurton ko gharon mein qaid rakho, yahaan tak ke maut un ki umren poori karde, ya Allah ta'ala un ke liye koi aur raasta nikaale.
ayahs.16: Tum mein se jo do afraad aisa kaam kar len unhe eeza do, agar woh tauba aur islaah kar len to un se munh pher lo, beshak Allah ta'ala tauba qubool karne wala aur reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.17: Allah ta'ala sirf unhi logon ki tauba qubool farmata hai jo ba-wajah naadaani koi buraai kar guzren, phir jald us se baaz aa jaayen aur tauba karen to Allah ta'ala bhi un ki tauba qubool karta hai, Allah ta'ala bade ilm wala, hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.18: Un ki tauba nahi jo buraaiyaan karte chale jaayen yahaan tak ke jab un mein se kisi ke paas maut aa jaaye to keh de ke main ne ab tauba ki, aur un ki tauba bhi qubool nahi jo kufr par hi mar jaayen, yahi log hain jin ke liye hum ne alamnak azaab taiyaar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.19: Imaan walo! Tumhe halaal nahi ke zabardasti aurton ko wirse mein le baitho, unhe is liye rok na rakho ke jo tum ne unhe de rakha hai us mein se kuch le lo, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh koi khuli buraai aur be-hayaai karen, un ke saath achhe tareeqe se bood-o-bash rakho, go tum unhe na-pasand karo lekin bahut mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko bura jaano, aur Allah ta'ala us mein bahut hi bhalaai kar de.
ayahs.20: Aur agar tum ek biwi ki jagah doosri biwi karna hi chaaho aur un mein se kisi ko tum ne khazana ka khazana de rakha ho, to bhi us mein se kuch na lo, kya tum use na-haq aur khula gunaah hote hue bhi le lo ge?
ayahs.21: Tum use kaise le lo ge haalaanke tum ek doosre se mil chuke ho aur un aurton ne tum se mazboot ahd-o-paimaan le rakha hai.
ayahs.22: Aur un aurton se nikaah na karo jin se tumhare baapon ne nikaah kiya hai magar jo guzar chuka hai, yeh be-hayaai ka kaam aur bughz ka sabab hai aur badi buri raah hai.
ayahs.23: Haraam ki gayin tum par tumhari maayen aur tumhari ladkiyaan aur tumhari behnen, tumhari phoophiyaan aur tumhari khaalaayen aur bhaai ki ladkiyaan aur behen ki ladkiyaan aur tumhari woh maayen jinhon ne tumhe doodh pilaaya ho aur tumhari doodh-shareek behnen aur tumhari saas aur tumhari woh parwarish karda ladkiyaan jo tumhari god mein hain, tumhari un aurton se jin se tum dukhool kar chuke ho, haan agar tum ne un se jima na kiya ho to tum par koi gunaah nahi aur tumhare sulbi sagge beton ki biwiyaan aur tumhara do behnon ka jama karna, haan jo guzar chuka so guzar chuka, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala bakhshne wala, meharban hai.
ayahs.24: Aur (haraam ki gayin) shauhar wali aurten magar woh jo tumhari milkiyat mein aa jaayen, Allah ta'ala ne yeh ahkaam tum par farz kar diye hain, aur un aurton ke siwa aur aurten tumhare liye halaal ki gayin ke apne maal ke mehr se tum un se nikaah karna chaaho, bure kaam se bachne ke liye na ke shahwat-raani karne ke liye, is liye jin se tum faaida uthaao unhe un ka muqarrar kiya hua mehr de do, aur mehr muqarrar ho jaane ke baad tum aapas ki razaamandi se jo tay kar lo us mein tum par koi gunaah nahi, beshak Allah ta'ala ilm wala, hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.25: Aur tum mein se jis kisi ko aazaad musalmaan aurton se nikaah karne ki poori wusat-o-taaqat na ho to woh musalmaan laundiyon se jin ke tum maalik ho (apna nikaah kar le), Allah tumhare aamaal ko bakhoobi jaanne wala hai, tum sab aapas mein ek hi to ho, is liye un ke maalikoon ki ijaazat se un se nikaah kar lo, aur qaaide ke mutaabiq un ke mehr un ko do, woh paak-daaman hon na ke alaaniya badkaari karne waaliyaan, na khufiya aashnaai karne waaliyaan, pas jab yeh laundiyaan nikaah mein aa jaayen phir agar woh be-hayaai ka kaam karen to unhe aadhi saza hai us saza se jo aazaad aurton ki hai. Kaneezon se nikaah ka yeh hukm tum mein se un logon ke liye hai jinhe gunaah aur takleef ka andesha ho aur tumhara zabt karna bahut behtar hai aur Allah ta'ala bada bakhshne wala aur badi rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.26: Allah ta'ala chahta hai ke tumhare waaste khoob khol kar bayaan kare aur tumhe tum se pehle ke (nek) logon ki raah par chalaaye aur tumhari tauba qubool kare, aur Allah ta'ala jaanne wala, hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.27: Aur Allah chahta hai ke tumhari tauba qubool kare aur jo log khwaahishaat ke pairav hain woh chahte hain ke tum is se bahut door hat jaao.
ayahs.28: Allah chahta hai ke tum se takhfeef kar de kyunke insaan kamzor paida kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.29: Aye imaan walo! Apne aapas ke maal na-jaayaz tareeqe se mat khaao, magar yeh ke tumhari aapas ki razaamandi se ho khareed-o-farokht, aur apne aap ko qatl na karo, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala tum par nihaayat meharban hai.
ayahs.30: Aur jo shakhs yeh (naafarmaaniyaan) sarkashi aur zulm se karega to anqareeb hum us ko aag mein daakhil karenge aur yeh Allah par aasaan hai.
ayahs.31: Agar tum un bade gunaahon se bachte raho ge jin se tum ko mana kiya jaata hai to hum tumhare chhote gunaah door kar denge aur izzat-o-buzurgi ki jagah daakhil karenge.
ayahs.32: Aur us cheez ki aarzu na karo jis ke baais Allah ta'ala ne tum mein se baaz ko baaz par buzurgi di hai, mardon ka us mein se hissa hai jo unhon ne kamaaya aur aurton ke liye un mein se hissa hai jo unhon ne kamaaya, aur Allah ta'ala se us ka fazl maango, yaqeenan Allah har cheez ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.33: Maa baap ya qaraabat-daar jo chhod maren us ke waaris hum ne har shakhs ke muqarrar kar diye hain aur jin se tum ne apne haathon muahida kiya hai unhe un ka hissa do, haqeeqatan Allah ta'ala har cheez par haazir hai.
ayahs.34: Mard aurton par haakim hain is wajah se ke Allah ta'ala ne ek ko doosre par fazeelat di hai aur is wajah se ke mardon ne apne maal kharch kiye hain, pas nek farmabardaar aurten khaawind ki adam-maujoodgi mein ba-hifazat-e-ilahi nigehdaasht rakhne waaliyaan hain aur jin aurton ki naafarmaani aur bad-dimaaghi ka tumhe khauf ho unhe naseehat karo aur unhe alag bistaron par chhod do aur unhe maar ki saza do, phir agar woh taabedaari karen to un par koi raasta talaash na karo, beshak Allah ta'ala badi bulandi aur badaai wala hai.
ayahs.35: Agar tumhe miyaan biwi ke darmiyaan aapas ki an-ban ka khauf ho to ek munsif mard walon mein se aur ek aurat ke ghar walon mein se muqarrar karo, agar yeh dono sulah karaana chaahenge to Allah dono mein milaap kara dega, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala poore ilm wala, poori khabar wala hai.
ayahs.36: Aur Allah ta'ala ki ibaadat karo aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek na karo aur maa baap ke saath sulook-o-ihsaan karo aur rishta-daaron se aur yateemon se aur miskeenon se aur qaraabat-daar humsaaye se aur ajnabi humsaaye se aur pehlu ke saathi se aur raah ke musaafir se aur un se jin ke maalik tumhare haath hain, (ghulaam kaneez) yaqeenan Allah ta'ala takabbur karne walon aur shekhi-khoron ko pasand nahi farmata.
ayahs.37: Jo log khud bukhl karte hain aur doosron ko bhi bukhl karne ko kehte hain aur Allah ta'ala ne jo apna fazl unhe de rakha hai use chhupa lete hain, hum ne un kaafiron ke liye zillat ki maar taiyaar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.38: Aur jo log apna maal logon ke dikhaawe ke liye kharch karte hain aur Allah ta'ala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan nahi rakhte aur jis ka hum-nasheen aur saathi shaitaan ho, woh badtareen saathi hai.
ayahs.39: Bhala un ka kya nuqsaan tha agar yeh Allah ta'ala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan laate aur Allah ta'ala ne jo unhe de rakha hai us mein kharch karte, Allah ta'ala unhe khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.40: Beshak Allah ta'ala ek zarra baraabar zulm nahi karta aur agar neki ho to use dugni kar deta hai aur khaas apne paas se bahut bada sawaab deta hai.
ayahs.41: Pas kya haal hoga jis waqt ke har ummat mein se ek gawaah hum laayenge aur aap ko un logon par gawaah bana kar laayenge.
ayahs.42: Jis roz kaafir aur Rasool ke naafarmaan aarzu karenge ke kaash! Unhe zameen ke saath hamwaar kar diya jaata aur Allah ta'ala se koi baat na chhupa sakenge.
ayahs.43: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum nashe mein mast ho namaz ke qareeb bhi na jaao, jab tak ke apni baat ko samajhne na lago aur janaabat ki haalat mein jab tak ke ghusl na kar lo, haan agar raah chalte guzar jaane wale ho to aur baat hai aur agar tum beemaar ho ya safar mein ho ya tum mein se koi qaza-e-hajat se aaya ho ya tum ne aurton se mubaasharat ki ho aur tumhe paani na mile to paak mitti ka qasd karo aur apne munh aur apne haath mal lo. Beshak Allah ta'ala maaf karne wala, bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.44: Kya tum ne unhe nahi dekha? Jinhe kitaab ka kuch hissa diya gaya hai, woh gumraahi khareedte hain aur chahte hain ke tum bhi raah se bhatak jaao.
ayahs.45: Allah ta'ala tumhare dushmanon ko khoob jaanne wala hai aur Allah ta'ala ka dost hona kaafi hai aur Allah ta'ala ka madadgaar hona bas hai.
ayahs.46: Baaz yahood kalimaat ko un ki theek jagah se her pher kar dete hain aur kehte hain ke hum ne suna aur naafarmaani ki aur sun is ke baghair ke tu suna jaaye aur hamari riayat kar! (Lekin is ke kehne mein) apni zabaan ko pech dete hain aur deen mein taana dete hain aur agar yeh log kehte ke hum ne suna aur hum ne farmabardaari ki aur aap suniye aur hamein dekhiye to yeh un ke liye bahut behtar aur nihaayat hi munaasib tha, lekin Allah ta'ala ne un ke kufr ki wajah se unhe laanat ki hai. Pas yeh bahut hi kam imaan laate hain,
ayahs.47: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Jo kuch hum ne naazil farmaya hai jo us ki bhi tasdeeq karne wala hai jo tumhare paas hai, us par imaan lao is se pehle ke hum chehre bigaad den aur unhe lauta kar peeth ki taraf kar den, ya un par laanat bhejen jaise hum ne hafte ke din walon par laanat ki hai, aur Allah ta'ala ka kaam kiya gaya.
ayahs.48: Yaqeenan Allah ta'ala apne saath shareek kiye jaane ko nahi bakhshta aur us ke siwa jise chaahe bakhsh deta hai aur jo Allah ta'ala ke saath shareek muqarrar kare us ne bahut bada gunaah aur bohtan baandha.
ayahs.49: Kya aap ne unhe nahi dekha jo apni paakeezgi aur sataish khud karte hain? Balke Allah ta'ala jise chaahe paakeeza karta hai, kisi par ek dhaage ke baraabar zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.50: Dekho yeh log Allah ta'ala par kis tarah jhoot baandhte hain aur yeh (harkat) sareeh gunaah hone ke liye kaafi hai.
ayahs.51: Kya aap ne unhe nahi dekha jinhe kitaab ka kuch hissa mila? Jo but ka aur baatil mabood ka aitiqaad rakhte hain aur kaafiron ke haq mein kehte hain ke yeh log imaan walon se ziyaada raah-e-raast par hain.
ayahs.52: Yahi woh log hain jinhe Allah ta'ala ne laanat ki hai aur jise Allah ta'ala laanat kar de, to us ka koi madadgaar na paayega.
ayahs.53: Kya un ka koi hissa saltanat mein hai? Agar aisa ho to phir yeh kisi ko ek khajoor ki guthli ke shigaaf ke baraabar bhi kuch na denge.
ayahs.54: Ya yeh logon se hasad karte hain us par jo Allah ta'ala ne apne fazl se unhe diya hai, pas hum ne to aal-e-Ibraheem ko kitaab aur hikmat bhi di hai aur badi saltanat bhi ata farmaayi hai.
ayahs.55: Phir un mein se baaz ne to is kitaab ko maana aur baaz is se ruk gaye, aur jahannam ka jalaana kaafi hai.
ayahs.56: Jin logon ne hamari aayaton se kufr kiya, unhe hum yaqeenan aag mein daal denge jab un ki khalain pak jaayengi hum un ke siwa aur khalain badal denge taake woh azaab chakhte rahen, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala ghaalib hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.57: Aur jo log imaan laaye aur shaista aamaal kiye hum anqareeb unhe un jannaton mein le jaayenge jin ke neeche nahren beh rahi hain, jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahenge, un ke liye wahaan saaf suthri biwiyaan hongi aur hum unhe ghani chhaon (aur poori raahat) mein le jaayenge.
ayahs.58: Allah ta'ala tumhe taakeedi hukm deta hai ke amaanat walon ki amaanaten unhe pahunchaao! Aur jab logon ka faisla karo to adl-o-insaaf se faisla karo! Yaqeenan woh behtar cheez hai jis ki naseehat tumhe Allah ta'ala kar raha hai. Beshak Allah ta'ala sunta hai, dekhta hai.
ayahs.59: Aye imaan walo! Farmabardaari karo Allah ta'ala ki aur farmabardaari karo Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki aur tum mein se ikhtiyaar walon ki. Phir agar kisi cheez mein ikhtilaaf karo to use lautaao, Allah ta'ala ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf, agar tumhe Allah ta'ala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan hai. Yeh bahut behtar hai aur baitibar-e-anjam ke bahut achha hai.
ayahs.60: Kya aap ne unhe nahi dekha? Jin ka daawa to yeh hai ke jo kuch aap par aur jo kuch aap se pehle utaara gaya hai us par un ka imaan hai, lekin woh apne faisle ghair Allah ki taraf le jaana chaahte hain haalaanke unhe hukm diya gaya hai ke shaitaan ka inkaar karen, shaitaan to yeh chaahta hai ke unhe bahka kar door daal de.
ayahs.61: Un se jab kabhi kaha jaaye ke Allah ta'ala ke naazil karda kalaam ki aur Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki taraf aao to aap dekh lenge ke yeh munaafiq aap se munh pher kar ruke jaate hain.
ayahs.62: Phir kya baat hai ke jab un par un ke kartoot ke baais koi museebat aa padti hai to phir yeh aap ke paas aa kar Allah ta'ala ki qasmen khaate hain ke hamara iraada to sirf bhalaai aur mel milaap hi ka tha.
ayahs.63: Yeh woh log hain ke un ke dilon ka bhed Allah ta'ala par bakhoobi roshan hai, aap un se chashm poshi kijiye, unhe naseehat karte rahiye aur unhe woh baat kahiye! Jo un ke dilon mein ghar karne wali ho.
ayahs.64: Hum ne har har Rasool ko sirf isi liye bheja ke Allah ta'ala ke hukm se us ki farmabardaari ki jaaye aur agar yeh log jab unhon ne apni jaanon par zulm kiya tha, tere paas aa jaate aur Allah ta'ala se istighfaar karte aur Rasool bhi un ke liye istighfaar karte, to yaqeenan yeh log Allah ta'ala ko maaf karne wala meharban paate.
ayahs.65: So qasam hai tere parwardigaar ki! Yeh momin nahi ho sakte, jab tak ke tamaam aapas ke ikhtilaaf mein aap ko haakim na maan len, phir jo faisle aap un mein kar den un se apne dil mein aur kisi tarah ki tangi aur na-khushi na paayen aur farmabardaari ke saath qubool kar len.
ayahs.66: Aur agar hum un par yeh farz kar dete ke apni jaanon ko qatl kar daalo! Ya apne gharon se nikal jaao! To use un mein se bahut hi kam log baja laate aur agar yeh wahi karen jis ki unhe naseehat ki jaati hai to yaqeenan yahi un ke liye behtar aur bahut ziyaada mazbooti wala hai.
ayahs.67: Aur tab to unhe hum apne paas se bada sawaab den.
ayahs.68: Aur yaqeenan unhe raah-e-raast dikha den.
ayahs.69: Aur jo bhi Allah ta'ala ki aur Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki farmabardaari kare, woh un logon ke saath hoga jin par Allah ta'ala ne in'aam kiya hai, jaise nabi aur siddiq aur shaheed aur nek log, yeh behtareen rafeeq hain.
ayahs.70: Yeh fazl Allah ta'ala ki taraf se hai aur kaafi hai Allah ta'ala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.71: Aye musalmano! Apne bachaao ka saamaan le lo phir grooh grooh ban kar kooch karo ya sab ke sab ikatthe ho kar nikal khade ho!
ayahs.72: Aur yaqeenan tum mein baaz woh bhi hain jo pas-o-pesh karte hain, phir agar tumhe koi nuqsaan hota hai to woh kehte hain ke Allah ta'ala ne mujh par bada fazl kiya ke main un ke saath maujood na tha.
ayahs.73: Aur agar tumhe Allah ta'ala ka koi fazl mil jaaye to is tarah ke goya tum mein un mein dosti thi hi nahi, kehte hain kaash! Main bhi un ke humraah hota to badi kaamyaabi ko pahuncha.
ayahs.74: Pas jo log dunya ki zindagi ko aakhirat ke badle bech chuke hain, unhe Allah ta'ala ki raah mein jihaad karna chaahiye aur jo shakhs Allah ta'ala ki raah mein jihaad karte hue shahadat paa le ya ghaalib aa jaaye, yaqeenan hum use bahut bada sawaab inaayat farmaayenge.
ayahs.75: Bhala kya wajah hai ke tum Allah ki raah mein aur un naatawaan mardon, aurton aur nanhe nanhe bachchon ke chhutkaare ke liye jihaad na karo? Jo yun duaayen maang rahe hain ke aye hamare parwardigaar! In zaalimon ki basti se hamein najaat de aur hamare liye khud apne paas se himaayati muqarrar kar de aur hamare liye khaas apne paas se madadgaar bana.
ayahs.76: Jo log imaan laaye hain woh to Allah ta'ala ki raah mein jihaad karte hain aur jin logon ne kufr kiya hai, woh Allah ta'ala ke siwa auron ki raah mein ladte hain pas tum shaitaan ke doston se jang karo! Yaqeen maano ke shaitaani heela (bilkul boda aur) sakht kamzor hai.
ayahs.77: Kya tum ne unhe nahi dekha jinhe hukm kiya gaya tha ke apne haathon ko roke rakho aur namazen padhte raho aur zakaat ada karte raho. Phir jab unhe jihaad ka hukm diya gaya to isi waqt un ki ek jamaat logon se is qadar darne lagi jaise Allah ta'ala ka dar ho, balke us se bhi ziyaada, aur kehne lage aye hamare Rabb! Tu ne hum par jihaad kyun farz kar diya? Kyun hamein thodi si zindagi aur na jeene di? Aap keh dijiye ke dunya ki soodmandi to bahut hi kam hai aur parhezgaaron ke liye to aakhirat hi behtar hai aur tum par ek dhaage ke baraabar bhi sitam rawa na rakha jaayega.
ayahs.78: Tum jahaan kahin bhi ho maut tumhe aa pakdegi, go tum mazboot qilon mein ho, aur agar unhe koi bhalaai milti hai to kehte hain ke yeh Allah ta'ala ki taraf se hai aur agar koi buraai pahunchti hai to keh uthte hain ke yeh teri taraf se hai. Unhe keh do ke yeh sab kuch Allah ta'ala ki taraf se hai. Unhe kya hogaya hai ke koi baat samajhne ke bhi qareeb nahi.
ayahs.79: Tujhe jo bhalaai milti hai woh Allah ta'ala ki taraf se hai aur jo buraai pahunchti hai woh tere apne nafs ki taraf se hai, hum ne tujhe tamaam logon ko paighaam pahunchaane wala bana kar bheja hai aur Allah ta'ala gawaah kaafi hai.
ayahs.80: Is Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki jo itaa'at kare usi ne Allah ta'ala ki farmabardaari ki aur jo munh pher le to hum ne aap ko kuch un par nigehbaan bana kar nahi bheja.
ayahs.81: Yeh kehte to hain ke itaa'at hai, phir jab aap ke paas se uth kar baahar nikalte hain to un mein ki ek jamaat, jo baat aap ne ya us ne kahi hai us ke khilaaf raaton ko mashware karti hai, un ki raaton ki baat cheet Allah likh raha hai, to aap un se munh pher len aur Allah par bharosa rakhen, Allah ta'ala kaafi karsaz hai.
ayahs.82: Kya yeh log Quran mein ghaur nahi karte? Agar yeh Allah ta'ala ke siwa kisi aur ki taraf se hota to yaqeenan is mein bahut kuch ikhtilaaf paate.
ayahs.83: Jahaan unhe koi khabar aman ki ya khauf ki mili unhon ne use mashhoor karna shuroo kar diya, haalaanke agar yeh log use Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke aur apne mein se aisi baaton ki teh tak pahunchne walon ke hawaale kar dete, to us ki haqeeqat woh log maloom kar lete jo nateeja akhaz karte hain aur agar Allah ta'ala ka fazl aur us ki rehmat tum par na hoti to maadoode chand ke alaawa tum sab shaitaan ke pairokaar ban jaate.
ayahs.84: To Allah ta'ala ki raah mein jihaad karta reh, tujhe sirf teri zaat ki nisbat hukm diya jaata hai, haan imaan walon ko raghbat dilaata reh, bahut mumkin hai ke Allah ta'ala kaafiron ki jang ko rok de aur Allah ta'ala sakht quwwat wala hai aur saza dene mein bhi sakht hai.
ayahs.85: Jo shakhs kisi neki ya bhale kaam ki sifaarish kare, use bhi us ka kuch hissa milega aur jo buraai aur badi ki sifaarish kare us ke liye bhi is mein se ek hissa hai, aur Allah ta'ala har cheez par qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.86: Aur jab tumhe salaam kiya jaaye to tum us se achha jawaab do ya unhi alfaaz ko lauta do, be-shubha Allah ta'ala har cheez ka hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.87: Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood (bar-haq) nahi woh tum sab ko yaqeenan qayamat ke din jama karega, jis ke (aane) mein koi shak nahi, Allah ta'ala se ziyaada sachchi baat wala aur kaun hoga.
ayahs.88: Tumhe kya hogaya hai? Ke munaafiqon ke baare mein do grooh ho rahe ho? Unhe to un ke aamaal ki wajah se Allah ta'ala ne aundha kar diya hai. Ab kya tum yeh mansoobe baandh rahe ho ke Allah ta'ala ke gumraah kiye huon ko tum raah-e-raast par laa khada karo, jise Allah ta'ala raah bhula de to hargiz us ke liye koi raah na paayega.
ayahs.89: Un ki to chaahat hai ke jis tarah ke kaafir woh hain to bhi un ki tarah kufr karne lago aur phir sab yaksaan ho jaao, pas jab tak yeh Islam ki khaatir watan na chhoden un mein se kisi ko haqeeqi dost na banaao, phir agar yeh munh pher len to unhe pakdo aur qatl karo jahaan bhi yeh haath lag jaayen, khabardaar! Un mein se kisi ko apna rafeeq aur madadgaar na samajh baithna.
ayahs.90: Siwaaye un ke jo us qaum se ta'alluq rakhte hon jin se tumhara muahida ho chuka hai ya jo tumhare paas is haalat mein aayen ke tum se jang karne se bhi tang dil hain aur apni qaum se bhi jang karne se tang dil hain aur agar Allah ta'ala chaahta to unhe tum par musallat kar deta aur woh tum se yaqeenan jang karte, pas agar yeh log tum se kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar kar len aur tum se ladaai na karen aur tumhari jaanib sulah ka paighaam daalen, to Allah ta'ala ne tumhare liye un par koi raah ladaai ki nahi ki.
ayahs.91: Tum kuch aur logon ko aisa bhi paaoge jin ki (bazaahir) chaahat hai ke tum se bhi aman mein rahen aur apni qaum se bhi aman mein rahen (lekin) jab kabhi fitna-angezi ki taraf lautaaye jaate hain to aundhe munh us mein daal diye jaate hain, pas agar yeh log tum se kinaara-kashi na karen aur tum se sulah ka silsila-jumbani na karen aur apne haath na rok len, to unhe pakdo aur maar daalo jahaan kahin bhi paalo! Yahi woh hain jin par hum ne tumhe zaahir hujjat inaayat farmaayi hai.
ayahs.92: Kisi momin ko doosre momin ka qatl kar dena zeba nahi magar ghalti se ho jaaye (to aur baat hai), jo shakhs kisi musalmaan ko bila-qasd maar daale, us par ek musalmaan ghulaam ki gardan aazaad karna aur maqtool ke azeezon ko khoon-baha pahunchaana hai. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh log ba-taur-e-sadqa maaf kar den aur agar maqtool tumhari dushman qaum ka ho aur ho woh musalmaan, to sirf ek momin ghulaam ki gardan aazaad karni laazmi hai. Aur agar maqtool us qaum se ho ke tum mein aur un mein ahd-o-paimaan hai to khoon-baha laazim hai, jo us ke kumbe walon ko pahunchaaya jaaye aur ek musalmaan ghulaam ka aazaad karna bhi (zaroori hai), pas jo na paaye us ke zimme do maheene ke lagataar roze hain, Allah ta'ala se bakhshwaane ke liye aur Allah ta'ala bakhoobi jaanne wala aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.93: Aur jo koi kisi momin ko qasdan qatl kar daale, us ki saza dozakh hai jis mein woh hamesha rahega, us par Allah ta'ala ka ghazab hai, use Allah ta'ala ne laanat ki hai aur us ke liye bada azaab taiyaar rakha hai.
ayahs.94: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum Allah ki raah mein ja rahe ho to tehqeeq kar liya karo aur jo tum se salaam alaik kare to use yeh na keh do ke tu imaan wala nahi. Tum dunyaawi zindagi ke asbaab ki talaash mein ho to Allah ta'ala ke paas bahut si ghaneematen hain. Pehle tum bhi aise hi the, phir Allah ta'ala ne tum par ehsaan kiya lihaaza tum zaroor tehqeeq-o-tafteesh kar liya karo, beshak Allah ta'ala tumhare aamaal se baa-khabar hai.
ayahs.95: Apni jaanon aur maalon se Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wale momin aur baghair uzr ke baithe rehne wale momin baraabar nahi, apne maalon aur apni jaanon se jihaad karne walon ko baithe rehne walon par Allah ta'ala ne darjon mein bahut fazeelat de rakhi hai aur yun to Allah ta'ala ne har ek ko khoobi aur achhaai ka waada diya hai lekin mujaahideen ko baithe rehne walon par bahut bade ajr ki fazeelat de rakhi hai.
ayahs.96: Apni taraf se martabe ki bhi aur bakhshish ki bhi aur rehmat ki bhi aur Allah ta'ala bakhshish karne wala aur reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.97: Jo log apni jaanon par zulm karne wale hain jab farishte un ki rooh qabz karte hain to poochhte hain, tum kis haal mein the? Yeh jawaab dete hain ke hum apni jagah kamzor aur maghloob the. Farishte kehte hain kya Allah ta'ala ki zameen kushaada na thi ke tum hijrat kar jaate? Yahi log hain jin ka thikaana dozakh hai aur woh pahunchne ki buri jagah hai.
ayahs.98: Magar jo mard aurten aur bachche be-bas hain jinhe na to kisi chara-e-kar ki taaqat aur na kisi raaste ka ilm hai.
ayahs.99: Bahut mumkin hai ke Allah ta'ala un se darguzar kare, Allah ta'ala darguzar karne wala aur maaf farmaane wala hai.
ayahs.100: Jo koi Allah ki raah mein watan ko chhodega, woh zameen mein bahut si qayaam ki jagahen bhi paayega aur kushaadgi bhi, aur jo koi apne ghar se Allah ta'ala aur us ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki taraf nikal khada hua, phir use maut ne aa pakda to bhi yaqeenan us ka ajr Allah ta'ala ke zimme saabit ho gaya, aur Allah ta'ala bada bakhshne wala meharban hai.
ayahs.101: Jab tum safar mein ja rahe ho to tum par namazon ke qasr karne mein koi gunaah nahi, agar tumhe dar ho ke kaafir tumhe sataayenge, yaqeenan kaafir tumhare khule dushman hain.
ayahs.102: Jab tum un mein ho aur un ke liye namaz khadi karo to chaahiye ke un ki ek jamaat tumhare saath apne hathiyaar liye khadi ho, phir jab yeh sajda kar chuken to yeh hat kar tumhare peechhe aa jaayen aur woh doosri jamaat jis ne namaz nahi padhi woh aa jaaye aur tere saath namaz ada kare aur apna bachaao aur apne hathiyaar liye rahe, kaafir chaahte hain ke kisi tarah tum apne hathiyaaron aur apne saamaan se be-khabar ho jaao to woh tum par achaanak dhaawa bol den, haan apne hathiyaar utaar rakhne mein us waqt tum par koi gunaah nahi jabke tumhe takleef ho ya ba-wajah baarish ke ya ba-sabab bimaar ho jaane ke aur apne bachaao ki cheezen saath liye raho, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala ne munkiron ke liye zillat ki maar taiyaar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.103: Phir jab tum namaz ada kar chuko to uthte baithte aur lete Allah ta'ala ka zikr karte raho aur jab itminaan paao to namaz qaaim karo! Yaqeenan namaz mominon par muqarrara waqton par farz hai.
ayahs.104: Un logon ka peechha karne se haare dil ho kar baith na raho! Agar tumhe be-aaraami hoti hai to unhe bhi tumhari tarah be-aaraami hoti hai aur tum Allah ta'ala se woh umeeden rakhte ho, jo umeeden unhe nahi, aur Allah ta'ala daana aur hakeem hai.
ayahs.105: Yaqeenan hum ne tumhari taraf haq ke saath apni kitaab naazil farmaayi hai taake tum logon mein us cheez ke mutaabiq faisla karo jis se Allah ne tum ko shanaasa kiya hai aur khiyaanat karne walon ke himaayati na bano.
ayahs.106: Aur Allah ta'ala se bakhshish maango! Beshak Allah ta'ala bakhshish karne wala, meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.107: Aur un ki taraf se jhagda na karo jo khud apni hi khiyaanat karte hain, yaqeenan dagha-baaz gunahgaar Allah ta'ala ko achha nahi lagta.
ayahs.108: Woh logon se to chhup jaate hain, (lekin) Allah ta'ala se nahi chhup sakte, woh raaton ke waqt jabke Allah ki naapasandeeda baaton ke khufiya mashware karte hain us waqt bhi Allah un ke paas hota hai, un ke tamaam aamaal ko woh ghere hue hai.
ayahs.109: Haan to yeh ho tum log ke dunya mein tum ne un ki himaayat ki lekin Allah ta'ala ke saamne qayamat ke din un ki himaayat kaun karega? Aur woh kaun hai jo un ka wakeel ban kar khada ho sakega?
ayahs.110: Jo shakhs koi buraai kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah se istighfaar kare to woh Allah ko bakhshne wala, meharbaani karne wala paayega.
ayahs.111: Aur jo gunaah karta hai us ka bojh usi par hai aur Allah bakhoobi jaanne wala aur poori hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.112: Aur jo shakhs koi gunaah ya khata kar ke kisi be-gunaah ke zimme thop de, us ne bahut bada bohtan uthaaya aur khula gunaah kiya.
ayahs.113: Agar Allah ta'ala ka fazl-o-reham tujh par na hota to un ki ek jamaat ne to tujhe behkaane ka qasd kar hi liya tha, magar dar-asal yeh apne aap ko hi gumraah karte hain, yeh tera kuch nahi bigaad sakte, Allah ta'ala ne tujh par kitaab-o-hikmat utaari hai aur tujhe woh sikhaaya hai jise tu nahi jaanta tha aur Allah ta'ala ka tujh par bada bhaari fazl hai.
ayahs.114: Un ke aksar khufiya mashwaron mein koi khair nahi, haan! Bhalaai us ke mashware mein hai jo khairaat ka ya nek baat ka ya logon mein sulah karaane ka hukm kare aur jo shakhs sirf Allah ta'ala ki razaamandi haasil karne ke iraade se yeh kaam kare use hum yaqeenan bahut bada sawaab denge.
ayahs.115: Jo shakhs baa-wujood raah-e-hidayat ke waazeh ho jaane ke bhi Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ka khilaaf kare aur tamaam mominon ki raah chhod kar chale, hum use udhar hi mutawajjah kar denge jidhar woh khud mutawajjah ho aur dozakh mein daal denge, woh pahunchne ki bahut hi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.116: Use Allah ta'ala qatan na bakhshega ke us ke saath shirk muqarrar kiya jaaye, haan shirk ke ilaawa gunaah jis ke chaahe maaf farma deta hai aur Allah ke saath shareek karne wala bahut door ki gumraahi mein ja pada.
ayahs.117: Yeh to Allah ta'ala ko chhod kar sirf aurton ko pukaarte hain aur dar-asal yeh sirf sarkash shaitaan ko poojte hain.
ayahs.118: Jise Allah ne laanat ki hai aur us ne beda uthaaya hai ke tere bandon mein se main muqarrar-shuda hissa le kar rahoonga.
ayahs.119: Aur unhe raah se behkaata rahoonga aur baatil umeeden dilaata rahoonga aur unhe sikhaaoonga ke jaanwaron ke kaan cheer den, aur un se kahoonga ke Allah ta'ala ki banaayi hui soorat ko bigaad den, suno! Jo shakhs Allah ko chhod kar shaitaan ko apna rafeeq banaayega woh sareeh nuqsaan mein doobega.
ayahs.120: Woh un se zabaani waade karta rahega, aur sabz baagh dikhaata rahega, (magar yaad rakho!) Shaitaan ke jo waade un se hain woh saraasar farebkaariyaan hain.
ayahs.121: Yeh woh log hain jin ki jagah jahannam hai, jahaan se unhe chhutkaara na milega.
ayahs.122: Aur jo imaan laayen aur bhale kaam karen hum unhe un jannaton mein le jaayenge jin ke neeche chashme jaari hain, jahaan yeh abadal-aabaad rahenge, yeh hai Allah ka waada jo saraasar sachcha hai aur kaun hai jo apni baat mein Allah se ziyaada sachcha ho?
ayahs.123: Haqeeqat-e-haal na to tumhari aarzu ke mutaabiq hai aur na ahl-e-kitaab ki umeedon par mauqoof hai, jo bura karega us ki saza paayega aur kisi ko na paayega jo us ki himaayat-o-madad, Allah ke paas kar sake.
ayahs.124: Jo imaan wala ho mard ho ya aurat aur woh nek aamaal kare, yaqeenan aise log jannat mein jaayenge aur khajoor ki guthli ke shigaaf baraabar bhi un ka haq na maara jaayega.
ayahs.125: baitibar-e-deen ke is se achha kaun hai? Jo apne ko Allah ke taabe kar de aur ho bhi nekokaar, saath hi yaksooi wale Ibraheem ke deen ki pairwi kar raha ho aur Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ko Allah ta'ala ne apna dost bana liya hai.
ayahs.126: Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch hai sab Allah hi ka hai aur Allah ta'ala har cheez ko gherne wala hai.
ayahs.127: Aap se aurton ke baare mein hukm daryaaft karte hain, aap keh dijiye! Ke khud Allah un ke baare mein hukm de raha hai aur Quran ki woh aayaten jo tum par un yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein padhi jaati hain jinhe un ka muqarrar haq tum nahi dete aur unhe apne nikaah mein laane ki raghbat rakhte ho aur kamzor bachchon ke baare mein aur is baare mein ke yateemon ki kaarguzaari insaaf ke saath karo. Tum jo nek kaam karo, be-shubha Allah use poori tarah jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.128: Agar kisi aurat ko apne shauhar ki bad-dimaaghi aur be-parwaahi ka khauf ho to dono aapas mein jo sulah kar len us mein kisi par koi gunaah nahi. Sulah bahut behtar cheez hai, tama har har nafs mein shaamil kar di gayi hai. Agar tum achha sulook karo aur parhezgaari karo to tum jo kar rahe ho us par Allah ta'ala poori tarah khabardaar hai.
ayahs.129: Tum se yeh to kabhi na ho sakega ke apni tamaam biwiyon mein har tarah adl karo, go tum us ki kitni hi khwaahish-o-koshish kar lo, is liye bilkul hi ek ki taraf maail ho kar doosri ko udhar latakti hui na chhodo aur agar tum islaah karo aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karo to, beshak Allah ta'ala badi maghfirat aur rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.130: Aur agar miyan biwi juda ho jaayen to Allah ta'ala apni wusat se har ek ko be-niyaaz kar dega, Allah ta'ala wusat wala hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.131: Zameen aur aasmaanon ki har har cheez Allah ta'ala hi ki milkiyat mein hai aur waaqai hum ne un logon ko jo tum se pehle kitaab diye gaye the aur tum ko bhi yahi hukm kiya hai ke Allah se darte raho aur agar tum kufr karo to yaad rakho ke Allah ke liye hai jo kuch aasmaanon mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai aur Allah bahut be-niyaaz aur tareef kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.132: Allah ke ikhtiyaar mein hain aasmaanon ki sab cheezen aur zameen ki bhi aur Allah karsaz kaafi hai.
ayahs.133: Agar use manzoor ho to aye logo! Woh tum sab ko le jaaye aur doosron ko le aaye, Allah ta'ala is par poori qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.134: Jo shakhs dunya ka sawaab chaahta ho to (yaad rakho ke) Allah ta'ala ke paas to dunya aur aakhirat (dono) ka sawaab maujood hai aur Allah ta'ala bahut sunne wala aur khoob dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.135: Aye imaan walo! Adl-o-insaaf par mazbooti se jam jaane wale aur khushnoodi-e-maula ke liye sachchi gawaahi dene wale ban jaao, go woh khud tumhare apne khilaaf ho ya apne maa baap ke ya rishtedaar azeezon ke, woh shakhs agar ameer ho to aur faqeer ho to dono ke saath Allah ko ziyaada taalluq hai, is liye tum khwaahish-e-nafs ke peechhe pad kar insaaf na chhod dena aur agar tum ne kaj-bayaani ya pehlu-tahi ki to jaan lo ke jo kuch tum karoge Allah ta'ala is se poori tarah ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.136: Aye imaan walo! Allah ta'ala par, us ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) par aur us kitaab par jo us ne apne Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) par utaari hai aur un kitaabon par jo is se pehle us ne naazil farmaayi hain, imaan laao! Jo shakhs Allah ta'ala se aur us ke farishton se aur us ki kitaabon se aur us ke Rasoolon se aur qayamat ke din se kufr kare woh to bahut badi door ki gumraahi mein ja pada.
ayahs.137: Jin logon ne imaan qubool kar ke phir kufr kiya, phir imaan laa kar phir kufr kiya, phir apne kufr mein badh gaye, Allah ta'ala yaqeenan unhe na bakhshega aur na unhe raah-e-hidayat samjhaayega.
ayahs.138: Munaafiqon ko is amar ki khabar pahuncha do ke un ke liye dardnaak azaab yaqini hai.
ayahs.139: Jin ki yeh haalat hai ke musalmaanon ko chhod kar kaafiron ko dost banaate phirte hain, kya un ke paas izzat ki talaash mein jaate hain? (To yaad rakhen ke) izzat to saari ki saari Allah ta'ala ke qabze mein hai.
ayahs.140: Aur Allah ta'ala tumhare paas apni kitaab mein yeh hukm utaar chuka hai ke tum jab kisi majlis walon ko Allah ta'ala ki aayaton ke saath kufr karte aur mazaaq udaate hue suno to is majma mein un ke saath na baitho! Jab tak ke woh is ke ilaawa aur baaten na karne lagen, (warna) tum bhi us waqt unhi jaise ho, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala tamaam kaafiron aur sab munaafiqon ko jahannam mein jama karne wala hai.
ayahs.141: Yeh log tumhare anjaam-e-kaar ka intizaar karte rehte hain phir agar tumhe Allah fatah de to yeh kehte hain ke kya hum tumhare saathi nahi aur agar kaafiron ko thoda sa ghalba mil jaaye to (un se) kehte hain ke hum tum par ghaalib na aane lage the aur kya hum ne tumhe musalmaanon ke haathon se na bachaaya tha? Pas qayamat mein khud Allah ta'ala tumhare darmiyaan faisla karega aur Allah ta'ala kaafiron ko imaan walon par hargiz raah na dega.
ayahs.142: Beshak munaafiq Allah se chaalbaaziyan kar rahe hain aur woh unhe is chaalbaazi ka badla dene wala hai aur jab namaz ko khade hote hain to badi kaahili ki haalat mein khade hote hain sirf logon ko dikhaate hain, aur yaad-e-ilahi to yun hi si baraaye naam karte hain.
ayahs.143: Woh darmiyaan mein hi muallaq dagmaga rahe hain, na poore un ki taraf na saheeh taur par un ki taraf aur jise Allah ta'ala gumraahi mein daal de to tu us ke liye koi raah na paayega.
ayahs.144: Aye imaan walo! Mominon ko chhod kar kaafiron ko dost na banaao, kya tum yeh chaahte ho ke apne oopar Allah ta'ala ki saaf hujjat qaaim kar lo.
ayahs.145: Munaafiq to yaqeenan jahannam ke sab se neeche ke tabaqe mein jaayenge, naamumkin hai ke tu un ka koi madadgaar paale.
ayahs.146: Haan jo tauba kar len aur islaah kar len aur Allah ta'ala par kaamil yaqeen rakhen aur khaalis Allah hi ke liye deendaari karen to yeh log mominon ke saath hain, Allah ta'ala mominon ko bahut bada ajr dega.
ayahs.147: Allah ta'ala tumhe saza de kar kya karega? Agar tum shukr guzaari karte raho aur baa-imaan raho, Allah ta'ala bahut qadr karne wala aur poora ilm rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.148: Buraai ke saath aawaaz buland karne ko Allah ta'ala pasand nahi farmaata magar mazloom ki ijaazat hai aur Allah ta'ala khoob sunta jaanta hai.
ayahs.149: Agar tum kisi neki ko alaaniya karo ya posheeda, ya kisi buraai se darguzar karo, pas yaqeenan Allah ta'ala poori maafi karne wala aur poori qudrat wala hai.
ayahs.150: Jo log Allah ke saath aur us ke paighambaron ke saath kufr karte hain aur jo log yeh chaahte hain ke Allah aur us ke Rasoolon ke darmiyaan farq rakhen aur jo log kehte hain ke baaz nabiyon par to hamara imaan hai aur baaz par nahi aur chaahte hain ke is ke aur is ke bain-bain koi raah nikaalen.
ayahs.151: Yaqeen maano ke yeh sab log asli kaafir hain, aur kaafiron ke liye hum ne ihaanat-aamez saza taiyaar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.152: Aur jo log Allah par aur us ke tamaam paighambaron par imaan laate hain aur un mein se kisi mein farq nahi karte, yeh hain jinhe Allah un ko poora sawaab dega aur Allah badi maghfirat wala badi rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.153: Aap se yeh ahl-e-kitaab darkhwaast karte hain ke aap un ke paas koi aasmaani kitaab laayen, Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) se to unhon ne is se bahut badi darkhwaast ki thi ke hamein khullam-khulla Allah ta'ala ko dikha de, pas un ke is zulm ke baa'is un par kadaake ki bijli aa padi phir baa-wujood yeh ke un ke paas bahut daleelen pahunch chuki thin unhon ne bachhde ko apna mabood bana liya, lekin hum ne yeh bhi maaf farma diya aur hum ne Moosa ko khula ghalba (aur sareeh daleel) inaayat farmaayi.
ayahs.154: Aur un ka qaul lene ke liye hum ne un ke saron par Toor pahaad laa khada kar diya aur unhe hukm diya ke sajda karte hue darwaaze mein jaao aur yeh bhi farmaya ke hafte ke din mein tajaawuz na karna aur hum ne un se sakht se sakht qaul-o-qaraar liye.
ayahs.155: (Yeh saza thi) ba-sabab un ki ahd-shikni ke aur ahkaam-e-ilahi ke saath kufr karne ke aur Allah ke nabiyon ko na-haq qatl kar daalne ke, aur is sabab se ke yun kehte hain ke hamare dilon par ghilaaf hai. Haalaanke dar-asal un ke kufr ki wajah se un ke dilon par Allah ta'ala ne mohar laga di hai, is liye yeh qadr-e-qaleel hi imaan laate hain.
ayahs.156: Aur un ke kufr ke baa'is aur Maryam par bahut bada bohtan baandhne ke baa'is.
ayahs.157: Aur yun kehne ke baa'is ke hum ne Allah ke Rasool Maseeh Eesa bin Maryam ko qatl kar diya haalaanke na to unhon ne use qatl kiya na sooli par chadhaaya balke un ke liye un (Eesa) ka shabeeh bana diya gaya tha. Yaqeen jaano ke Hazrat Eesa (alaihis salaam) ke baare mein ikhtilaaf karne wale un ke baare mein shak mein hain, unhe is ka koi yaqeen nahi bajuz takhmeeni baaton par amal karne ke, itna yaqini hai ke unhon ne unhe qatl nahi kiya.
ayahs.158: Balke Allah ta'ala ne unhe apni taraf utha liya aur Allah bada zabardast aur poori hikmaton wala hai.
ayahs.159: Ahl-e-kitaab mein ek bhi aisa na bachega jo Hazrat Eesa (alaihis salaam) ki maut se pehle un par imaan na laa chuke aur qayamat ke din aap un par gawaah honge.
ayahs.160: Jo nafees cheezen un ke liye halaal ki gayi thin woh hum ne un par haraam kar din un ke zulm ke baa'is aur Allah ta'ala ki raah se aksar logon ko rokne ke baa'is.
ayahs.161: Aur sood jis se mana kiye gaye the use lene ke baa'is aur logon ka maal na-haq maar khaane ke baa'is aur un mein jo kuffaar hain hum ne un ke liye alamnak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai.
ayahs.162: Lekin un mein se jo kaamil aur mazboot ilm wale hain aur imaan wale hain jo is par imaan laate hain jo aap ki taraf utaara gaya aur jo aap se pehle utaara gaya aur namazon ko qaaim rakhne wale hain aur zakaat ke ada karne wale hain aur Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhne wale hain yeh hain jinhe hum bahut bade ajr ata farmaayenge.
ayahs.163: Yaqeenan hum ne aap ki taraf isi tarah wahi ki hai jaise ke Nooh (alaihis salaam) aur un ke baad wale nabiyon ki taraf ki, aur hum ne wahi ki Ibraheem aur Ismaeel aur Ishaaq aur Yaqoob aur un ki aulaad par aur Eesa aur Ayyub aur Younus aur Haaroon aur Sulaiman ki taraf. Aur hum ne Daaood (alaihis salaam) ko Zaboor ata farmaayi.
ayahs.164: Aur aap se pehle ke bahut se Rasoolon ke waaqiaat hum ne aap se bayaan kiye hain aur bahut se Rasoolon ke nahi bhi kiye aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) se Allah ta'ala ne saaf taur par kalaam kiya.
ayahs.165: Hum ne unhe Rasool banaaya hai, khushkhabriyaan sunaane wale aur aagaah karne wale taake logon ki koi hujjat aur ilzaam Rasoolon ke bhejne ke baad Allah ta'ala par reh na jaaye. Allah ta'ala bada ghaalib aur bada baa-hikmat hai.
ayahs.166: Jo kuch aap ki taraf utaara hai us ki baabat khud Allah ta'ala gawaahi deta hai ke use apne ilm se utaara hai aur farishte bhi gawaahi dete hain aur Allah ta'ala ba-taur gawaah kaafi hai.
ayahs.167: Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ta'ala ki raah se auron ko roka woh yaqeenan gumraahi mein door nikal gaye.
ayahs.168: Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur zulm kiya, unhe Allah ta'ala hargiz hargiz na bakhshega aur na unhe koi raah dikhaayega.
ayahs.169: Bajuz jahannam ki raah ke jis mein woh hamesha hamesha pade rahenge, aur yeh Allah ta'ala par bilkul aasaan hai.
ayahs.170: Aye logo! Tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki taraf haq le kar Rasool aa gaya hai, pas tum imaan laao taake tumhare liye behtari ho aur agar tum kaafir hogaye to Allah hi ki hai har woh cheez jo aasmaanon aur zameen mein hai, aur Allah daana hai hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.171: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Apne deen ke baare mein hadd se na guzar jaao aur Allah par bajuz haq ke aur kuch na kaho, Maseeh Eesa bin Maryam (alaihis salaam) to sirf Allah ta'ala ke Rasool aur us ke kalime (kun se paida-shuda) hain, jise Maryam (alaiha salaam) ki taraf daal diya tha aur us ke paas ki rooh hain is liye tum Allah ko aur us ke sab Rasoolon ko maano aur na kaho ke Allah teen hain, is se baaz aa jaao ke tumhare liye behtari hai, Allah ibaadat ke laaiq to sirf ek hi hai aur woh is se paak hai ke us ki aulaad ho, usi ke liye hai jo kuch aasmaanon mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai. Aur Allah kaafi hai kaam banaane wala.
ayahs.172: Maseeh (alaihis salaam) ko Allah ka banda hone mein koi nang-o-aar ya takabbur-o-inkaar hargiz ho hi nahi sakta aur na muqarrab farishton ko, us ki bandagi se jo bhi dil churaaye aur takabbur-o-inkaar kare, Allah ta'ala un sab ko ikattha apni taraf jama karega.
ayahs.173: Pas jo log imaan laaye hain aur shaaista aamaal kiye hain un ko un ka poora poora sawaab inaayat farmaayega aur apne fazl se unhe aur ziyaada dega aur jin logon ne nang-o-aar aur sarkashi aur inkaar kiya, unhe alamnak azaab dega aur woh apne liye siwaaye Allah ke koi himaayati, aur imdaad karne wala na paayenge.
ayahs.174: Aye logo! Tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki taraf se sanad aur daleel aa pahunchi aur hum ne tumhari jaanib waazeh aur saaf noor utaar diya hai.
ayahs.175: Pas jo log Allah ta'ala par imaan laaye aur use mazboot pakad liya, unhe to woh anqareeb apni rehmat aur fazl mein le lega aur unhe apni taraf ki raah-e-raast dikha dega.
ayahs.176: Aap se fatwa poochhte hain, aap keh dijiye ke Allah ta'ala (khud) tumhe kalala ke baare mein fatwa deta hai. Agar koi shakhs mar jaaye jis ki aulaad na ho aur ek behen ho to us ke liye chhode hue maal ka aadha hissa hai aur woh bhai us behen ka waaris hoga agar us ke aulaad na ho. Pas agar behnen do hon to unhe kul chhode hue ka do tihaai milega. Aur agar kai shakhs is naate ke hain mard bhi aur aurten bhi to mard ke liye hissa hai misl do aurton ke, Allah ta'ala tumhare liye bayaan farma raha hai ke aisa na ho ke tum behak jaao aur Allah ta'ala har cheez se waaqif hai.
